subject: Re: travel timing
text: Thank you for the earlier message. As a student, I have checked the schedule again, and the afternoon connection is unreliable after the weather notice. I can leave two hours earlier and arrive before the conference session, if that remains convenient. Please let me know whether you still prefer the original arrival time. If the train changes, I will keep the ticket flexible and send another update promptly. I appreciate your patience with this coordination. I would rather avoid last minute surprises for both of us.
